source_problem: The declared Set(BookCopy) result and collect projection need an explicit duplicate-handling interpretation when multiple qualifying Loans refer to the same BookCopy.
approved_preconditions: The overdue active-loan collection can be resolved.
approved_postconditions: Return the BookCopy objects linked to the selected user's unreturned Loans with an overdue fee greater than zero.
Each BookCopy object appears once even when multiple qualifying Loans refer to it.
Different BookCopy objects remain separate even when their attribute values are equal.
fixture_identity_note: copy_key and in_selected_user_history describe fixture identities and membership in the selected user's LoanedBook association; they are not added model attributes. Deduplication is by object identity, not barcode, title, serialization or structural equality.
correction_scope: Clarify the declared Set result as identity-based deduplication after the existing user-history, unreturned-loan and positive-fee filter. Preserve the uid parameter and Set(BookCopy) return type. Add no extra eligibility filter, global state-frame condition or model field.
